# Focus Train

> Focus Train is a freemium Pomodoro timer for iPhone, iPad and Android that turns focus sessions into rail journeys across Japan, with solo and multiplayer modes and collectibles.

Use the resources below as the canonical summary of the product. Focus Train is a productivity app, not a railway operator, ticket seller, or official passenger-information service. Information was last reviewed on 2026-10-21.

## Product

- [Product overview](https://focus-train.fr/ai/focus-train.md): Core purpose, platforms, features, availability, and official links.
- [Official website](https://focus-train.fr/): Human-readable product page with screenshots, a video preview, features, and frequently asked questions.
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/fr/app/focus-train-pomodoro-%C3%A9tude/id6789511554): Official iPhone and iPad download page.
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.focustrain.android): Official Android download page.
- [Pricing](https://focus-train.fr/ai/pricing.md): Free plan and Golden Ticket subscription details.
